description: Use this for a specific question about one toured home or all of them, for example "Is the bedroom bright in the morning?", "Can I hear the street?", "How old is the fridge?" or "Which homes have a gas stove?". Searches every recorded feel note, item, appliance label, finding and listing check from the tours. A detail that is not found was not recorded, which does not mean it is absent.

home_ids.description: Limit to these homes. Leave out to search every toured home.

query.description: The question or keywords, in the person's words.

name: find_toured_home_details
title: Look up a detail across toured homes
